thread:
Olivia Chen: Heads up — ZephyrHealth on Dedicated reported a sudden spike of 401 Unauthorized responses while they were running an audit export. They say it started ~2026-03-12 09:10 UTC and lasted a few minutes. They want confirmation on scope and whether audit continuity was impacted.
Raj Patel: Do we have any x-request-id samples or request timestamps? Also was there a deploy or maintenance around that window? @oncall-bot any infra events?
oncall-bot: New deploy to svc-auth at 2026-03-12T09:09:58Z by deploy-bot. No incident created by the deploy pipeline.
Maria Gomez: Customer pasted this sample header: `x-request-id: zh-4512`, route: `/v1/exports/audit`, response: `401 {"error":"token_expired"}`. Tagging @Security-Eng for scope/impact.
Security-Eng: If it's `token_expired` at the auth gateway, requests would be rejected before export storage. First checks: any KMS/HSM anomalies or token service errors at 09:09-09:14?
Raj Patel: I'm pulling metrics now — small spike in KMS RPC timeouts and transient 5xxs around 09:10-09:13 UTC. Pulling auth gateway logs and request traces.
Olivia Chen: Customer is asking whether we need to notify downstream customers and legal. They want an initial acknowledgement and an ETA for a full timeline.
Maria Gomez: If the failure is during token refresh, the requests never authenticated and won't appear as successful export writes. We'll need to produce a list of affected request ids and timestamps for Zephyr. @Security-Eng can you confirm if there were any `export_write_failures`?
Security-Eng: Checked export pipeline — no write failures recorded during the window. Auth gating failures only. So data storage appears intact; the gap is limited to requests rejected at auth. We'll prepare a scope: timestamps + request ids and cause hypothesis.
Olivia Chen: Proposed customer response: we observed auth gating failures from 09:10:02 to 09:13:21 UTC affecting 62 requests from ZephyrHealth. We will provide a full timeline and remediation notes within 48 hours. Agree?
Raj Patel: :thumbsup: I'll extract logs, redact PII, and attach the list. ETA ~2 hours.
Maria Gomez: Drafting ticket and CC'ing legal and compliance. Draft note to ZephyrHealth:
````
We observed a transient auth token refresh error impacting audit export requests between 2026-03-12 09:10:02 UTC and 2026-03-12 09:13:21 UTC. During this period 62 requests from your account returned 401 and were rejected at the authentication layer. Our export storage shows no failed writes. We are investigating root cause (initial hypothesis: temporary KMS RPC timeouts after a key-cache refresh) and will follow up with a detailed timeline and remediation steps within 48 hours.
````
Security-Eng: Please add a technical note: KMS client observed short RPC timeouts coincident with our key-cache refresh; we'll run HSM health checks and share results. If confirmed, we'll propose a config change to reduce refresh-induced RPC pressure.
Olivia Chen: Great — I'll send the ack to the customer now and update the incident ticket when the log bundle is ready. Thanks team.
